title: CPU physics simulation or trace collision queries
fix_rationale: Physics load can be reduced by tuning Chaos solver iterations, simplifying collision geometry, or caching scene trace queries.
evidence_template: {timer} took {ms} ms evaluating Chaos physics simulation or collision traces ({share}% of excess time).

fixes.text: Ensure inactive rigid bodies enter sleep state; disable collision on non-interactive aesthetic meshes.
Replace complex per-poly collision queries with simple primitives (capsule/box).
Tune Chaos solver sub-stepping and position iteration counts in Project Settings.

verify: Re-run test scene and ensure Chaos simulation time drops below 3 ms per frame.
